notes.title: 🛠️ Demo Update: Improved Physics-Based Throwing!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We've just pushed an update to the Journey Through the Undead demo, and it makes throwing stuff at zombies way more satisfying.

You could always grab and throw items before, but now the system has been refined for smoother physics, better accuracy, and more impactful hits. Whether it's a table, a chair, or whatever else you can grab, it now feels faster, and more fun to use in a fight.

Check out this short clip of me testing it out by hurling objects at some unfortunate undead:
[previewyoutube=q8bZqR0uw6M;full][/previewyoutube]

Give it a try in the updated demo and let us know how it feels!

Thanks for playing,
Dazzling Divine

notes.title: New Game Mode Update
notes.notes:
Enjoy this new awesome zombie horde mode, where you fight for your life until you could escape the area.

[previewyoutube=wxJ9o4_I3o0;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

With this update we fixed several more bugs and also make the character movement more robust and easy to handle. 



We've been developing this game for four months now starting back in May this year. So far we managed to come up with a lot of new features than we had at the initial early access launch. We also made a great deal of bug fixes too. 

Hope you will stay with us and give us your feedback until we finish the game.

notes.title: New Game Mode Update
notes.notes:
Enjoy this new game mode where you have to fight zombies in a smaller map. Unlike in the survival mode, in this mode you will have the ability to roll, forward flip and backflip without the need to unlock them as separate skills, which allows players to move effectively while fighting. This is just the first experimental version of the mode and will be significantly improved based on your feedback. 

[previewyoutube=xsSVhnUaWIc;full][/previewyoutube]

With this and previous update, a number of new features has been added to the game. 

- Grenades, Explosive Barrels (Press G to throw and hold G to select between grenades)
- Ability to Melee Attack when equipped with a gun.
- Ability to climb certain objects.
- Press Q to quickly use available health kits without worrying about opening the inventory.
- Added a Flash Light (Hold F to Turn On/Off). Batteries must be collected in order to use it.


In the time to come, we plan to release more maps and the ability to unlock new maps by spending the kill points you earn within the Horde Mode. Further, bare hand combat and better combat system for melee weapons are among the planned updates.

All of these depends on what you like and dislike about our game. Therefore, let us know what you think about the new features and things you expect in the future.

notes.title: Significant Performance Improvements
notes.notes:
- This update improves the frame rate up to 20% and also reduce the stuttering that happened time to time.
- Small updates to the map.
- Fixed bugs in takedown system.
- Tweaked zombie attacks to reduce the difficulty.

notes.title: New Features Update
notes.notes: [previewyoutube=MMeMyslm2Pk;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Roll, Flips and Stealth Takedown
notes.notes:
Features included,

- Roll and Flips. Players can now use it to avoid upcoming attacks. 
- Stealth Takedown. 
- Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Details about Bug Fixes so far
notes.notes:
- Reduced the number of zombie hordes so that the difficulty of the game becomes reasonable. We'll continue to tweak more settings based on the players responses to the current state of the game. 

- Fixed the issue where the game freezes after player dies and now the game restarts/reloads the last checkpoint instantly with no lag.

- Fixed the weapon disappearing issue. Major improvements to the weapon and combat system will be done in the future.

- Added the option to chose to turn off Global Illumination and Ray Traced Reflections in the graphics settings. Now the game runs smoother in low end systems. 

- Fixed inability to close the building system window. We'll fix all the interface related issues as soon as possible. 

- Fixed collision issues when in crouching mode.

- Added more details to the map and also optimized foliage for better performance.

notes.title: Swimming System Update
notes.notes: This update improves the Basic swimming system implemented in the previous update by adding a temporary oxygen level when the player is under water. Enjoy!
